
![](data:image/png;base64,)

Species: Hobgoblin, for ‘saving face’ feature.

Appearance: Red skin, black hair, yellow eyes, elegant witch-like black robes.

Class: Sorcerer, link with privilege of being born rich and being born with magic. Maybe multiclass rogue.

Subclass: Aberrant mind.

Background: Noble  
  
Magic Item: Would have to be an inconspicuous item, my favourite idea is a hairpin. 

Inspiration: The Bene Gesserit, Luthen Rael.

“My anger, my ego, my unwillingness to yield, my eagerness to fight, they’ve set me on a path from which there is no escape. I yearn to be a saviour against injustice without contemplating the cost and by the time I look down there is no longer any ground beneath my feet.” 

Pitch: Taught the ins and outs of politics by his father. Taught the ins and outs of people's minds by his mother. Taught the nature of evil in the navy.

He wasn't involved in the ‘Red Mutiny,’ freeing a shipment of slaves and staining the sea with the blood of a fleet of captains. But the rest of his crew were, his parents made sure his actions were swept under the rug before disowning him.    

He yearns to be a martyr but is condemned to be a masked, puppetmaster who’s always just out of reach. Forced to make his enemies believe he’s just two steps ahead, only for them to realise he’s not the one they're chasing. Just once he wants to exist in the open.
